signature.output_contract: The number of 1-bits in `n`'s binary encoding.

signature.core_task: Determine whether a target node is reachable from a start node in a directed graph using breadth-first traversal.
signature.input_contract: A directed-graph start node and goal node.
signature.output_contract: A boolean indicating reachability.

signature.core_task: Sort a list of small nonnegative integers using their bounded value range.
signature.input_contract: List `arr` of integers and integer upper bound `k`.
signature.output_contract: The elements of `arr` in sorted order.
constraints: Every element satisfies 0 <= element < k.
Use the stated bucket-sort task for the bounded integer range.

signature.core_task: Determine whether a target node is reachable from a start node in a directed graph using depth-first traversal.
signature.input_contract: A directed-graph start node and goal node.
signature.output_contract: A boolean indicating reachability.

signature.core_task: Determine whether a singly linked list contains a cycle using tortoise-and-hare cycle detection.
signature.input_contract: The head node of a linked list.
signature.output_contract: A boolean indicating whether the list is cyclic.
constraints: Use the tortoise-and-hare method.

signature.core_task: Find the first occurrence of a target value in a sorted integer list.
signature.input_contract: A sorted integer list `arr` and target value `x`.
signature.output_contract: The lowest index containing `x`, or -1 if absent.

signature.core_task: Find an occurrence of a target value in a sorted integer list.
signature.input_contract: A sorted integer list `arr` and target value `x`.
signature.output_contract: An index containing `x`, or -1 if absent.

signature.core_task: Traverse a nested list structure and yield all non-list elements as a single flat sequence.
signature.input_contract: A list potentially containing arbitrarily nested lists, with no containment cycles.
signature.output_contract: A generator yielding non-list objects in traversal order.
constraints: The input has no list containment cycles.

signature.core_task: Compute the greatest common divisor of two nonnegative integers.
signature.input_contract: Nonnegative integers `a` and `b`.
signature.output_contract: The greatest integer dividing both inputs evenly.
constraints: Both inputs are integers.

signature.core_task: Compute the prime factorization of an integer using trial division.
signature.input_contract: An integer `n` with n >= 1.
signature.output_contract: A sorted list of prime factors, including repeated factors.
constraints: Use naive trial division.

signature.core_task: Produce the shortest legal sequence of moves solving a Towers of Hanoi puzzle.
signature.input_contract: Nonnegative height and distinct valid start and end pegs numbered 1 through 3.
signature.output_contract: An ordered list of `(source_peg, destination_peg)` moves.
constraints: Each move transfers one top disk.
Never place a disk on a smaller disk.
The sequence must move the entire stack to the specified end peg.

signature.core_task: Check whether a string of parentheses is properly balanced and nested.
signature.input_contract: A string containing only `(` and `)`.
signature.output_contract: A boolean indicating valid parenthesization.

signature.core_task: Sort an almost-sorted array by yielding its elements in ascending order.
signature.input_contract: A list of unique integers and nonnegative displacement bound `k`; each element is at most `k` positions from its sorted position.
signature.output_contract: A generator yielding the elements in sorted order.
constraints: The algorithm must run in O(n log k) time.
Input elements are unique.
Each element's displacement is at most `k`.

signature.core_task: Compute the maximum total value achievable by selecting a subset of items whose total weight does not exceed the knapsack capacity.
signature.input_contract: An integer capacity and a list of (weight, value) pairs.
signature.output_contract: The maximum achievable total value.

signature.core_task: Return the element that would occupy zero-based position k in the ascending ordering of an integer list.
signature.input_contract: A list of integers and an integer k.
signature.output_contract: The kth-lowest element.
constraints: 0 <= k < len(arr)

signature.core_task: Determine the length of the longest contiguous substring occurring in both input strings.
signature.input_contract: Two strings.
signature.output_contract: The length of their longest common substring.

signature.core_task: Compute the minimum number of single-character insertions, deletions, and substitutions required to transform one string into another.
signature.input_contract: A source string and a target string.
signature.output_contract: The Levenshtein edit distance.

signature.core_task: Find the length of the longest subsequence whose elements are in strictly increasing order.
signature.input_contract: A sequence of integers.
signature.output_contract: The length of the longest increasing subsequence.
constraints: All integers in the sequence are unique.

signature.core_task: Return a longest sequence that appears as a subsequence of both input strings.
signature.input_contract: Two strings.
signature.output_contract: One longest common subsequence; any tied result is acceptable.

signature.core_task: Compute the maximum sum over all contiguous sublists, including the empty sublist if permitted by the specified range.
signature.input_contract: A list of integers.
signature.output_contract: The maximum contiguous-sublist sum.

signature.core_task: Return the elements of an integer list in sorted order.
signature.input_contract: A list of integers.
signature.output_contract: The sorted elements as a list.

signature.core_task: Find a set of graph edges connecting every vertex with minimum possible total weight.
signature.input_contract: A dictionary mapping each undirected edge, represented by an endpoint pair, to its weight.
signature.output_contract: A set of edges forming a minimum spanning tree.
constraints: The input graph is connected.

signature.core_task: Construct the smallest palindromic integer strictly greater than the given palindromic integer.
signature.input_contract: An array of base-10 digits in most-significant-to-least-significant order.
signature.output_contract: The digit array representing the next palindrome.
constraints: The input digit array represents a palindrome.

signature.core_task: Return the lexicographically smallest permutation that is greater than the given permutation.
signature.input_contract: A list of unique integers.
signature.output_contract: The lexicographically next permutation.
constraints: The input is not in reverse-sorted order.

signature.core_task: Generate the first n rows of Pascal's triangle.
signature.input_contract: An integer n.
signature.output_contract: A list containing n rows, each represented as a list of integers.

signature.core_task: Count the distinct combinations of the supplied coin denominations whose values sum to a target total, disregarding ordering of coins.
signature.input_contract: A list of positive integer coin denominations and an integer target total.
signature.output_contract: The number of distinct combinations producing the total.

signature.core_task: Enumerate every subset of a list's elements.
signature.input_contract: A list with no duplicate elements.
signature.output_contract: A list of lists representing all subsets, including the empty subset and the full list.
constraints: The input list contains no duplicate elements.

signature.core_task: Return the elements of an integer list in sorted order.
signature.input_contract: A list of integers.
signature.output_contract: The sorted elements as a list.

signature.core_task: Reverse the successor relationships of an acyclic singly linked list and return its new head.
signature.input_contract: The head node of an acyclic singly linked list.
signature.output_contract: The head of the reversed linked list.
constraints: The list is acyclic.
The operation mutates the nodes' successor pointers.

signature.core_task: Evaluate a four-operation arithmetic expression encoded in reverse Polish notation.
signature.input_contract: A list containing floats and the operator strings '+', '-', '*', or '/'.
signature.output_contract: The numeric result of evaluating the expression.
constraints: Every token is a float or one of '+', '-', '*', '/'.

signature.core_task: Compute the shortest-path length from a start node to a goal node in a directed weighted graph.
signature.input_contract: A mapping from ordered directed edges to positive lengths, a start node, and a goal node.
signature.output_contract: The length of the shortest path from start to goal.
constraints: All edge lengths are positive.

signature.core_task: Compute shortest-path lengths for every ordered pair of nodes in a directed weighted graph.
signature.input_contract: The number of nodes and a mapping from ordered node pairs to edge lengths; node IDs are 0 through n-1.
signature.output_contract: A mapping from ordered node pairs to their shortest-path lengths.
constraints: The graph has no negative-length cycles.

signature.core_task: Compute the minimum path weight from a source node to every reachable node in a directed weighted graph.
signature.input_contract: A source node ID and a mapping from ordered directed edges to weights.
signature.output_contract: A mapping from each node ID to its minimum path weight from the source.
constraints: The graph has no negative-weight cycles.

signature.core_task: Convert a valid infix token sequence containing integers and binary arithmetic operators into equivalent Reverse Polish Notation using operator precedence and associativity.
signature.input_contract: tokens is a list whose elements are integers or one of +, -, *, and /.
signature.output_contract: Return the tokens reordered as an equivalent RPN expression.
constraints: Use the shunting-yard conversion semantics.

signature.core_task: Generate all prime numbers up to a specified inclusive upper bound.
signature.input_contract: max is a positive integer upper bound.
signature.output_contract: Return a list containing every prime number less than or equal to max.
constraints: Use the Sieve of Eratosthenes approach.

signature.core_task: Approximate the square root of a value to within a specified tolerance.
signature.input_contract: x is a float with x >= 1; epsilon is a positive float.
signature.output_contract: Return a float within epsilon of sqrt(x), inclusive.
constraints: Implement the approximation using the Newton-Raphson method.

signature.core_task: Enumerate all strictly ascending integer sequences of a specified length drawn from a half-open integer range.
signature.input_contract: a and b are integers; k is a positive integer; the source range is [a, b).
signature.output_contract: Return a list of all length-k ascending sequences from the range, as lists of integers.

signature.core_task: Convert a positive base-10 integer to its representation in a specified radix.
signature.input_contract: num is a positive base-10 integer; b is an integer from 2 through 36.
signature.output_contract: Return a string representing num in base b, using standard digit symbols through 9 and letters through Z.

signature.core_task: Produce a topological ordering of the elements in a directed acyclic graph.
signature.input_contract: nodes is a list of directed graph nodes; the graph is acyclic.
signature.output_contract: Return an OrderedSet containing the nodes in an order where each node precedes every node it has an edge to.

signature.core_task: Wrap text into lines at word boundaries while respecting a maximum line width and preserving the original text when the lines are concatenated.
signature.input_contract: text is the input string; cols is a positive integer maximum line length.
signature.output_contract: Return an ordered list of lines, each at most cols characters long, whose concatenation equals text and whose words are not split unless necessary.
constraints: Preserve the original spaces, including spaces at line starts or ends.
